node_diff_with_children: Prompt for generating visual difference analysis for DOM nodes that have child elements. Aggregates child differences and verifies them against parent screenshots. Used in bottom-up DOM tree processing.
node_diff_leaf: Prompt for generating visual difference analysis for leaf DOM nodes (elements without children). Compares original vs translated screenshots and computed styles to identify visual discrepancies.
root_verification: Prompt for verifying and filtering the aggregated differences at the root node level. Reviews all detected differences against the full page screenshots and assigns noticeability scores.
